3ffb8633-9a4a-4a5d-89c3-eef04f595887.title: Cho‘kish
3ffb8633-9a4a-4a5d-89c3-eef04f595887.description: Bola suvda cho‘kish xavfiga duch kelganda hayotini saqlab qoluvchi choralar. Har bir soniya muhim - darhol yordam ko‘rsating.

3d10cfcf-ae59-4a79-8466-c059cfacf237.title: Tutqanoq
3d10cfcf-ae59-4a79-8466-c059cfacf237.description: Bolada tutqanoq (jumladan, isitma tufayli tutqanoq) yuz berganda xotirjamlikni saqlab, to‘g‘ri yordam ko‘rsating. Ko‘pincha 2-5 daqiqada o‘tib ketadi.

32fc9ec7-a94d-4b87-b763-5c9b4f5b174f.title: Yuqori isitma
32fc9ec7-a94d-4b87-b763-5c9b4f5b174f.description: Chaqaloqning tana harorati 38°C dan yuqori bo‘lsa, xotirjamlik bilan to‘g‘ri choralar ko‘ring. Isitmani tushirish bo‘yicha bosqichma-bosqich ko‘rsatma.

a179f75b-57c8-42dd-b5ff-79de9d408477.title: Kuyishlar
a179f75b-57c8-42dd-b5ff-79de9d408477.description: Kuyganda darhol sovuq suv bilan yordam ko‘rsating. Kuyish darajasiga qarab tegishli birinchi yordam choralarini ko‘ring.

e08bd13a-ef13-4cbd-9cbf-ae890a86ddd8.title: Yiqilish
e08bd13a-ef13-4cbd-9cbf-ae890a86ddd8.description: Chaqaloq yoki bola yiqilib, jarohat olganida vaziyatni xotirjamlik bilan baholang. Bosh bilan urilgan hollarda alohida e’tibor talab etiladi.

c58927c2-7f46-4fe8-a01b-f61f711d6b89.title: Allergik reaksiya
c58927c2-7f46-4fe8-a01b-f61f711d6b89.description: Allergik reaksiya belgilarini aniqlang: qichishish, shish va nafas qisishi. Anafilaksiya holatida darhol 103 raqamiga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

c998bd27-265d-49a7-b171-5dae9479eafa.title: Burundan qon ketishi
c998bd27-265d-49a7-b171-5dae9479eafa.description: Burundan qon ketishini to‘xtatish uchun to‘g‘ri usul. Bolaning boshini orqaga tashlamasligi va xotirjam turishi muhim.

48a1fae9-01a3-47ec-9bea-247b9ce6811b.title: Zaharlanish
48a1fae9-01a3-47ec-9bea-247b9ce6811b.description: Bola zararli moddani (dori, kimyoviy modda yoki o‘simlikni) yutib yuborsa, darhol chora ko‘ring. Qustirish har doim ham to‘g‘ri emas — bu moddaning turiga bog‘liq.

53142be3-62de-48c9-8908-13e625cf3959.title: Hasharot chaqishi
53142be3-62de-48c9-8908-13e625cf3959.description: Ari, qovog‘ari yoki boshqa hasharot chaqqanda birinchi yordam. Allergik reaksiya belgilarini kuzating.

8c0564ef-fb10-485d-8ef3-0379da0ee782.title: Kesilish va jarohat
8c0564ef-fb10-485d-8ef3-0379da0ee782.description: Kesilish, shilinish yoki chuqur jarohatlarda qon ketishini to‘xtatish va yarani to‘g‘ri tozalash.

53ec6dc4-8484-403f-860e-0359596d3f09.title: Quyosh urishi
53ec6dc4-8484-403f-860e-0359596d3f09.description: Issiqda uzoq vaqt qolish natijasida yuz beradigan quyosh urishi va issiqdan holsizlanish holatlarida yordam ko‘rsatish.

6c78bbbc-bfbe-4fbe-8dfd-7d9dba5791a2.title: Elektr toki urishi
6c78bbbc-bfbe-4fbe-8dfd-7d9dba5791a2.description: Bolani elektr toki urganda xavfsiz yordam ko‘rsatish usullari. O‘zingizni ham ehtiyot qiling!

ea0bb6c0-37b9-4343-add3-ba50276fe174.title: Tish jarohati
ea0bb6c0-37b9-4343-add3-ba50276fe174.description: Bolaning tishi shikastlanganda yoki tushib qolganda to‘g‘ri birinchi yordam ko‘rsating. Tishni saqlab qolish imkoniyatini oshiring.

8439166d-bd26-4831-a151-d3e80eb7508d.title: Bo‘g‘ilish
8439166d-bd26-4831-a151-d3e80eb7508d.description: Chaqaloq yoki bola bo‘g‘ilib qolganda ko‘rsatiladigan birinchi yordam bosqichlari. Nafas yo‘llaridagi to‘siqni bartaraf etish uchun darhol yordam ko‘rsatish zarur.
